text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: McQueeeeeen!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Save me, save meee!! Nature and Machitan 
are launching an enemy raid, aaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An enemy raid? That sounds rather 
alarming, desu wa. What in the world 
happened?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I showed Nature and Machitan my test score 
from the other day, and then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Got my test back! 17 points!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
17 points is pretty much the same as last 
time! Which means~... this time again~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup, remedial classes! So I can't go to 
karaoke anymore!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you cry last time too because you 
couldn't go hang out? And yet here we are 
again?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
'Cause tests are way too hard! I hate 
tests!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll head over the second remedial class 
ends! Just keep singing and wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: (*Jumps!*)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously fine with this?! With 
losing out on spending time with everyone 
over and over like this!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that... Ughhh, Machitan~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmghhhhh~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Turbo, this isn't good!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gyaah?! Even Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...No no no no! I don't care anymore! You 
two are Turbo's enemies, aaaaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So that is what occurred... —In that case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Go study!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Even McQueen! Are you Turbo's enemy too?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san. Those two did not get angry 
because they are your enemies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
They scolded you because they simply 
cannot leave you to struggle on your own, 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: 'Cause they can't leave me alone...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I too was recently scolded by Ikuno-san. 
And it resonated deeply within my heart...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It did not resonate merely because I was 
scolded. It reached me because I felt 
Ikuno-san's heartfelt care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please try to feel what the person 
scolding you is wishing for in their 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Did they scold you just because they were 
annoyed with you, Turbo-san? —Surely that 
is not the case.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Nature... Machitan...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna study!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, help me study! And if Turbo 
slacks off, get mad at me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall gladly do so, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I heard 
Mejiro McQueen's scolding voice and Twin 
Turbo fired up about something.
choice_data_list: Let's go see what they're up to

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san, you were looking away again! 
Focus, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uwooooh!! Turbo will focus!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you...! Take a look. Turbo-san is 
working quite diligently on her studies.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna do her best, yeeeah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I cheered them on and decided to leave. Do 
your best, Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I cheered them on and decided to leave. Do 
your best, Twin Turbo!
